# KhonsuGraph

> Built for Hunters. Open-source, local-first graph investigation workbench on HawDB, for macOS and Windows. Cypher and PostgreSQL SQL, a graph canvas, path exploration, record-level evidence, graph algorithms, saved investigations, data-source plugins (CSV, AWS, Neo4j) and reviewable .dash dashboards, with a JSON CLI for AI agents. Independent of HawDB. Apache-2.0.

## Overview

- [English overview](https://khonsugraph.com/index.md)
- [中文介绍](https://khonsugraph.com/zh/index.md)
- [Source](https://github.com/JetSquirrel/KhonsuGraph)

## Documentation

- [All guides in one file](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/llms-full.txt)
- [中文文档合集](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/zh/llms-full.txt)
- [Getting started](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/getting-started.md): install, create a graph, import a CSV
- [Data sources](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/data-sources.md): CSV, AWS and Neo4j plugins, sync semantics
- [Cypher & SQL](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/queries.md): supported Cypher, shortest paths, limits
- [Investigations](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/investigations.md): explore paths, evidence, saved investigations, snapshots
- [Graph analysis](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/analysis.md): PageRank, betweenness, communities, components
- [Dashboards](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/dashboards.md): the .dash format
- [CLI & AI agents](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/cli.md): the khonsu JSON CLI and the agent skill
- [Plugin development](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/plugins.md): the JSON Lines plugin protocol
- [Examples](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/examples.md): dashboards on public datasets
- [Troubleshooting](https://khonsugraph.com/docs/troubleshooting.md): locks, old formats, empty panels
